prediction.likelyOutcome: SMK is likely to win summary judgment on liability against Tres Botes, with the dollar recovery close to (but possibly trimmed below) the pleaded $189,200 once mitigation and post-sale assignment issues are addressed. SDP's parallel motion against Dos Botes is unlikely to be granted as filed because the renewal's very existence is genuinely disputed and SDP's own 2013 deed raises an unresolved standing problem; that claim is better characterized as a real toss-up headed toward trial, worth somewhere between nothing and the full $324,000 depending on whether SDP can produce proof of the signed renewal and its continuing interest in the property.

outcome.description: Trial court (judgment signed September 22, 2025) granted summary judgment awarding SMK $79,096.44 against Tres Botes (18 months plus one prorated month at $4,300 until the property was sold) and SDP $108,000 against Dos Botes (12 months at $9,000 until relet), $187,096.44 total; no attorney's fees mentioned. On appeal the $79,096.44 award to SMK was affirmed; the $108,000 award to SDP was reversed and remanded because SDP did not conclusively prove the lease was renewed.
outcome.finalNote: $79,096.44 affirmed; the $108,000 Dos Botes award reversed and remanded, so the final total could rise.
